description: Classify an IPv4 address using the GreyNoise Community dataset (BYO API key). Returns: noise (mass internet scanner?), riot (known-good service like Google/AWS?), classification (malicious|benign|unknown), entity name, last-seen date, and a viz.greynoise.io deep link for SOC triage.
name: ip_context

last_seen.description: ISO date when the IP was last observed

link.description: Deep link to GreyNoise visualization page for this IP

name.description: Name or organization associated with the IP

noise.description: Whether the IP is classified as internet background noise

observed.description: Whether GreyNoise has observed scanner activity from this IP

riot.description: Whether the IP is a known good service (RIOT)

title: Ip Context
